persona: Mid-level motor control firmware engineer at a drives company
resumeText:
Rohit Deshmukh | Pune | rohit.deshmukh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Motor Control Engineer, Sahyadri Drives Pvt Ltd, Pune (2020 - present)
- Developed field oriented control with SVPWM for a 3 kW PMSM traction motor on a TI C2000 microcontroller.
- Tuned current and speed PI loops on the dynamometer for stable torque response.
- Wrote embedded C interrupt routines for the PWM and ADC control cycle.
- Built motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB/Simulink and generated code with Embedded Coder.
- Implemented sensorless control with a sliding-mode observer for ceiling fan BLDC motors.
- Debugged gate driver faults and IGBT desaturation trips on the three-phase inverter with an oscilloscope.

EDUCATION
BE Electrical Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2020

SKILLS
Python, Git
